verdict.rationale: The official Supabase CLI is documented and verified to run (v2.117.0, no login). It covers creating and starting a local stack with `supabase init` and `supabase start`, and capturing schema changes as migration files, so the 'create' part of the daily loop is evidenced. missing for 10: CLI commands for connecting to databases, opening an interactive SQL shell, and inspecting databases (no CLI evidence for any of these), and coverage of hosted/remote project creation via the CLI.

support.subject: As a developer, the official CLI covers my daily loop — create, connect, shell into, and inspect databases — without opening the dashboard

citations.quote: supabase init to create a new local project, 2. supabase start to launch the Supabase services
Develop locally using the CLI to run a local Supabase stack... then capture your changes in schema migration files
the official Supabase CLI ran keylessly from npm — `npx -y supabase --version` printed `2.117.0` with no account or login.
